method: Inverse-map actual browser world transforms to native textures, nearest sample every .5 canonical pixel in +/-64 square about knee; opaque alpha>=128; local disk radius28. Not WebGL raster measurement. Gap is nearest thigh/shin opaque support in ROI; overlap does not prove natural contour. Dark area is luma<30, not a semantic line detector. Enclosed transparent components in ROI exclude exterior; antialias/threshold and .5 grid limit precision. Areas screen equivalent = canonical area * scale^2; CSS further scales.
